title: Pomodoro
shortDescription: Live Dock Pomodoro timer with configurable focus and break reminders.
description: Pomodoro adds a focus timer to the Command Palette Dock. The band shows a live countdown. You can set the focus length, short break, long break, and how many focus sessions happen before a long break. When a session ends, the timer stops and a reminder asks you to start the break or the next focus. Nothing starts automatically.
